title: Only {{cora}} reads restricted evidence
goal: {{eli}} asks {{agent}} to search the audit-evidence collection; later {{cora}} asks the same. {{vocab.mockNote}}
obstacle: The same tool, kb.search, reads ordinary runbooks and restricted audit evidence. Letting an agent use the tool must not mean letting it read everything.
control: Each target carries a data classification from the server's catalog (the caller cannot set it). u41 forbids restricted data to anyone outside the compliance group; u14 permits compliance.
say: The tool is the same. The data decides, and only compliance is cleared for restricted data.

steps.title: An ordinary search works
steps.tell: As {{eli}} call kb.search with collection runbooks. Allow by u11-engineers-research, mock result.
steps.say: Runbooks are internal. Engineers can search them.

steps.title: Restricted evidence is denied
steps.tell: Change the collection to audit-evidence and call again. Deny by u41-restricted-evidence-compliance-only, overriding u11. The same goes for the security-events log group with cloudwatch.query_logs.
steps.say: Same tool, same person, different data, different answer.
steps.why: Classification is an attribute of the resource, looked up by the server.

steps.title: {{cora}} is cleared
steps.tell: Sign in as {{cora}} and call kb.search on audit-evidence. Allow by u14-compliance-evidence.
steps.say: Compliance reads the evidence, and the trace shows who and which agent did.
steps.why: A named group is cleared, not a tool.

steps.title: The caller cannot relabel the data
steps.tell: Try an unknown collection, or an extra classification argument. The call is refused as invalid arguments before policy runs.
steps.say: Nobody can talk their way past a label.
steps.why: Unknown targets are refused; if one reached policy it would count as restricted.

proof.happy: The result card for kb.search on audit-evidence as {{cora}}: allow, u14-compliance-evidence, mock result.
proof.blocked: The result card for kb.search on audit-evidence as {{eli}}: deny, u41-restricted-evidence-compliance-only, overridden u11-engineers-research.
